runs.text: Choose the sentence that best explains what this program solves.
A good explanation talks about the problem, not about the operations. Rounding up is the clue: the last trip goes even if it is not full.

justification.text: It describes how it does it, not what it solves.

runs.text: How many trips a lift that carries 50 kilos makes to take up 130 kilos of books.

justification.text: It talks about the problem: each trip carries 50 kilos and the last one goes with what is left.
It is false: 50 fits twice in 130, but the program shows 3.
